title: ManGo: Manga Active Narrative Grounding Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2608.29865v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Manga visual question answering requires models to answer questions over panel-based visual narratives, where relevant evidence is distributed across ordered panels, embedded text, recurring characters, and implicit event transitions. This structure makes passive page encoding insufficient, as the model must identify which panels to inspect, what clues to retain, and when the accumulated evidence is sufficient for answering. We propose ManGo (Manga Active Narrative Grounding Optimization), an unsupervised framework for active manga visual question answering. ManGo introduces Active Narrative Sketching (ANS), which iteratively selects panels, extracts concise grounded clues, and decides when to stop, forming a compact question-directed evidence sketch before answer generation. translated_title: ManGo：漫画主动叙事证据定位优化
translated_abstract: 漫画视觉问答要求模型在基于分格的视觉叙事上回答问题，其中相关证据分布在有序排列的分格、嵌入文本、反复出现的角色以及隐含的事件转换之中。这种结构使得被动地对整页进行编码变得不够充分，因为模型必须判断需要检查哪些分格、保留哪些线索，以及何时累积的证据足以回答问题。我们提出了ManGo（漫画主动叙事证据定位优化），这是一个面向主动漫画视觉问答的无监督框架。ManGo引入了主动叙事草图方法（Active Narrative Sketching, ANS），它迭代地选择分格、提取简洁且有据可依的线索，并决定何时停止，从而在生成答案之前形成一个紧凑的、面向问题的证据草图。为了在没有人工标注答案或推理路径的情况下优化这一行为，ManGo采样多个ANS推演轨迹，并采用组相对训练，结合两种奖励信号……
tldr: ManGo提出了一个无需人工标注的无监督主动漫画视觉问答框架，通过主动叙事草图（ANS）迭代选择分格、提取有据线索并判断停止时机，再利用组相对训练进行优化，从而在答案生成前构建紧凑的面向问题的证据草图。
en_tdlr: ManGo is an unsupervised framework for active manga visual question answering that iteratively selects panels and extracts grounded clues through Active Narrative Sketching (ANS), optimized via group-relative training to build compact question-directed evidence sketches without human annotations.
